pages.title: A pot over the fire
text: The Hearth Pot is a wide clay pot in a copper cradle. Set it **over heat**: a lit campfire, fire, magma, lava or an Ember Bowl right under it. It asks no Pulse at all, so it is a camp's first machine.
Open it, put up to **four ingredients** in the square, and a **bowl** beside them when the meal wants one. A meal takes about **12 seconds** over the fire and comes out on the right.
Every [tribe dish](tribe_dishes) and every [feast](feasts) is a Hearth Pot recipe. The order of the ingredients does not matter. JEI lists them all under the pot.
Hoppers feed it from the top and sides and take the meal from the bottom, so a pot can keep a camp fed on its own. Pack makers can add their own meals as recipes of the hearth type.
